newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stock market value hits new high in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stock market value hits new high in 1996.

text.p: The market value of Taiwan's main stock exchange hit a record high of T$7.524 trillion at the end of 1996, the China Times newspaper reported on Sunday.
The newspaper did not give a figure for the previous record.

Quoting statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the paper said as of the end of 1996, a total of 382 companies had listed on the exchange, with a combined paid-in capital of T$1.66 trillion, up 23.3 percent from end-1995.
Of the 382, 42 listed firms each had a paid-in capital of more than T$10 billion. Their combined capitalisation accounted for 46 percent of the market's total capital, the paper said.
China Steel topped the list, with paid-in capital of T$72 billion, followed by Cathay Life Insurance with T$30.4 billion and United Microelectronics with T$27.5 billion.

Many of these big-capitalised shares have become known as bellwether shares since the increased participation of foreign funds in early 1996 turned the market more toward fundamentals and away from speculation.
